pages.title: Hermione Granger Holding Her Wand in Her Gryffindor School Uniform Outside Hogwarts Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hermione Granger holding her wand outside Hogwarts Castle, wearing her Gryffindor uniform with a striped tie and lion crest. Her wavy hair and pleated skirt add narrower sections to the coloring sheet, while the robe sleeves offer larger spaces. Castle towers, rocky slopes, and a stone parapet frame her.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Wearing the Sorting Hat on the Stool in the Great Hall Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermione Granger sits on a stool wearing the Sorting Hat in this printable coloring page, with her hands folded neatly in her lap. The hat's crooked tip and deep folds rise above her wavy hair, while candles and tall windows establish the Great Hall setting. This coloring sheet combines broad robe panels with smaller tie stripes and window diamonds.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Levitating a Feather in Professor Flitwick's Charms Classroom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Hermione Granger levitating a feather in Professor Flitwick's Charms classroom, pointing her wand upward as the professor watches nearby. Curved motion lines surround the floating feather, and diamond-paned windows fill the background. Her open robe and pleated skirt provide larger coloring sections beside the smaller feather and uniform details.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Raising Her Hand in Professor Mcgonagall's Transfiguration Classroom Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermione Granger raises her hand in Professor McGonagall's Transfiguration classroom in this printable coloring page, seated at a desk with a closed book. Her other hand rests on its cover beneath a large blank board. The coloring sheet includes wavy hair, a striped school tie, stone wall blocks, and rows of desks behind her.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Reading a Spellbook Between the Shelves of the Hogwarts Library Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hermione Granger reading an open spellbook between the Hogwarts library shelves, holding the large volume with both hands in her school robes. Rows of differently sized books surround her, with an arched window behind her head. The coloring sheet offers repeated book-spine sections alongside broad sleeves and flowing strands of hair.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Writing an Essay with a Quill Beside the Gryffindor Common Room Fireplace Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermione Granger writes an essay with a quill beside the Gryffindor common room fireplace in this printable coloring page, seated at a round table. An inkpot and stacked books sit near her parchment, while a lion banner hangs beside an armchair. Flames, hair strands, and uniform details add smaller areas to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Sheltering Behind a Broken Bathroom Sink From a Mountain Troll Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Hermione Granger sheltering behind a broken bathroom sink as a mountain troll approaches with a raised club among scattered rubble. She crouches beside the cracked basin, looking back at the troll. Broken floor pieces, exposed taps, and tall bathroom arches give this coloring sheet a detailed setting around the two figures.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Cheering for Gryffindor From the Quidditch Stands in Her House Scarf Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermione Granger cheers for Gryffindor from the Quidditch stands in this printable coloring page, raising a fist while wearing a long striped house scarf. Her other hand grips the front railing, with goal hoops and pennants visible behind her. The scarf's repeated bands and fringe create smaller sections beside the broad robe sleeves on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Solving the Potion-bottle Riddle on the Way to the Philosopher's Stone Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hermione Granger solving the potion-bottle riddle on the way to the Philosopher's Stone, studying seven differently shaped bottles with a quill ready. Her other hand rests beneath her chin above a sheet of parchment. A spiral bottle, a heart-shaped vessel, and a tall arched doorway distinguish this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Brewing Polyjuice Potion in Moaning Myrtle's Bathroom Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermione Granger brews Polyjuice Potion in Moaning Myrtle's bathroom in this printable coloring page, stirring a round cauldron while holding a leaf above the mixture. Corked ingredient jars, loose sprigs, and a bowl sit on the table. The coloring sheet balances the large cauldron and robe sections with smaller leaves, bubbles, and background floor tiles.

pages.title: Hermione Granger with Cat Ears and Whiskers After a Polyjuice Potion Mistake Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Hermione Granger with cat ears and whiskers after a Polyjuice Potion mistake, sitting beside a bathroom sink in her school uniform. Her pointed ears rise through her wavy hair, and her hands rest together on her lap. Broad robe folds contrast with the smaller tie stripes and diamond window panes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Carrying a Torn Basilisk Book Page and a Small Mirror Through Hogwarts Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermione Granger carries a torn basilisk book page and a small mirror through Hogwarts in this printable coloring page, wearing her tie and open school robes. The ragged page shows a fanged serpent, while the oval mirror has a curling decorative frame. Stone arches, tiled flooring, and a tall window add background sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Repotting a Mandrake While Wearing Earmuffs in the Hogwarts Greenhouse Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hermione Granger repotting a mandrake in the Hogwarts greenhouse, wearing fluffy earmuffs, gloves, and an apron over her school clothes. She holds the leafy plant above a large pot, with soil falling from its dangling roots. A trowel and surrounding potted plants add detailed sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Choosing Crookshanks at the Magical Menagerie in Diagon Alley Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermione Granger chooses Crookshanks at the Magical Menagerie in this printable coloring page, reaching toward the fluffy cat as he sits on the shop counter. His flat face and thick, curling tail stand out beside her school robes. An owl, a parrot, and a rabbit appear in background cages, adding smaller subjects to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Holding Crookshanks on Her Lap in the Gryffindor Common Room Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Hermione Granger holding Crookshanks on her lap in the Gryffindor common room, seated in an armchair beside a burning fireplace. Her hand rests on his thick fur, and his bushy tail curves across her knees. The coloring sheet includes a lion banner, decorative chair studs, and small uniform details around the central pair.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Throwing a Small Stone Toward the Window of Hagrid's Hut Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermione Granger throws a small stone toward the window of Hagrid's hut in this printable coloring page, standing outside with one arm extended forward. Motion lines mark the stone's path toward the diamond-paned window. Her pleated skirt, the hut's irregular stones, a nearby barrel, and patches of grass provide varied sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Leading Buckbeak Away From the Pumpkin Patch Beside Hagrid's Hut Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hermione Granger leading Buckbeak away from the pumpkin patch beside Hagrid's hut, holding a loose lead as they walk together. Buckbeak's hooked beak, layered feathers, and large front talons fill much of the scene. Pumpkins, leafy vines, and the hut's tiled roof add smaller details to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Confronting Draco Malfoy with Her Wand Outside Hagrid's Hut Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermione Granger confronts Draco Malfoy outside Hagrid's hut in this printable coloring page, holding her wand upright as the two face each other in uniform. Draco stands with open hands and a startled expression. The hut's steep tiled roof, stone walls, and ring-handled door provide background detail around the broad robe panels on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Helping Harry Potter Practice the Summoning Charm with a Flying Book Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Hermione Granger helping Harry Potter practice the Summoning Charm, gesturing toward a flying book as he points his wand at it. Curved lines show the book moving between them in a Hogwarts classroom. Tall windows, stacked books, and long floorboards frame the two students, with broad robe sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Wearing Her Tiered Yule Ball Dress on the Hogwarts Staircase Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermione Granger wears her tiered Yule Ball dress on the Hogwarts staircase in this printable coloring page, resting one hand on the stone banister. Ruffled sleeves and cascading skirt layers define the gown, with curled hair gathered partly back. This coloring sheet pairs wide dress panels with narrower folds, stair edges, and arched railing openings.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Dancing with Viktor Krum Beneath the Yule Ball Decorations Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Hermione Granger dancing with Viktor Krum at the Yule Ball, with their hands joined beneath hanging snowflake decorations and draped fabric. Hermione wears a layered gown, while Viktor's high-collared jacket has a row of decorative fastenings. The coloring sheet includes flowing skirt folds, curled hair, and tall columns around the couple.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Knitting Woolly Hats for House-elves Beside a Basket of Yarn Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermione Granger knits woolly hats for house-elves in this printable coloring page, sitting in an armchair beside a basket filled with yarn and finished hats. A strand runs from the basket to the small hat on her needles. Repeated stitches, basket weaving, and ribbed cuffs create fine details beside the broad chair sections on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Holding a Glass Jar Containing Rita Skeeter in Beetle Form Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hermione Granger holding a glass jar containing Rita Skeeter in beetle form, standing beneath the pointed arches of a Hogwarts corridor. She supports the lidded jar with both hands, keeping the beetle visible at its base. The coloring sheet offers broad robe and stone sections alongside the insect's small legs and wings.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Collecting Signatures for Dumbledore's Army at the Hog's Head Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermione Granger collects signatures for Dumbledore's Army at the Hog's Head in this printable coloring page, holding a quill above parchment while another student sits opposite. A large tankard rests on the table, with a boar's head plaque and candle behind her. Her wavy hair and the room's planks add repeated details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Enchanting Dumbledore's Army Coins with the Protean Charm Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Hermione Granger enchanting Dumbledore's Army coins with the Protean Charm, aiming her wand at a coin on a table. Sparkles and curling lines surround the central coin, with several others scattered nearby. Her striped tie and wavy hair add fine sections above the open circular shapes and broad tabletop on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Conjuring Her Otter Patronus in the Room of Requirement Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermione Granger conjures her otter Patronus in the Room of Requirement in this printable coloring page, extending her wand beneath the floating animal and sweeping magical trails. Small stars surround the otter, while a padded practice target stands nearby. The coloring sheet includes arched columns, stone floor tiles, and broad robe panels around the spellcasting pose.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Wearing Her Prefect Badge While Guiding First-year Students Through a Hogwarts Corridor Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hermione Granger wearing her prefect badge while guiding first-year students through a Hogwarts corridor, carrying books and gesturing ahead. Two younger students follow her beneath a series of pointed arches. The coloring sheet combines large robe sections with smaller book edges, tie stripes, stone blocks, and the shield-shaped badge.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Dueling a Masked Death Eater Among the Prophecy Shelves in the Department of Mysteries Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermione Granger duels a masked Death Eater in this printable coloring page, holding her wand forward among the towering prophecy shelves in the Department of Mysteries. The hooded opponent points a wand back at her as curling spell lines cross the aisle. Repeated glass spheres and shelf uprights create detailed background sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Examining a Cauldron of Amortentia in Professor Slughorn's Classroom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Hermione Granger examining Amortentia in Professor Slughorn's classroom, holding a book beside a cauldron with twisting plumes rising from its bubbling surface. Potion bottles fill the nearby table and shelves, while an arched window stands behind her. The coloring sheet includes broad cauldron sections, small corks, and flowing hair strands.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Conjuring a Flock of Small Birds in an Empty Hogwarts Classroom Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermione Granger conjures a flock of small birds in an empty Hogwarts classroom in this printable coloring page, raising her wand toward their outstretched wings. Curved trails sweep from the wand around the flying birds. A tall diamond-paned window and unoccupied desks frame the coloring sheet, with large open spaces between the individual feathered shapes.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Sharing Butterbeer with Harry Potter and Ron Weasley at the Three Broomsticks Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hermione Granger sharing Butterbeer with Harry Potter and Ron Weasley at the Three Broomsticks, seated between them with a foaming mug. All three smile around a round table in front of a fireplace. Ribbed tankards, striped ties, stonework, and table grain add repeated details throughout this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Standing with Ron Weasley at Bill and Fleur's Wedding at the Burrow Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermione Granger stands with Ron Weasley at Bill and Fleur's wedding at the Burrow in this printable coloring page, beneath a canopy trimmed with flowers and bows. Her layered dress and flower necklace accompany Ron's long formal coat and buttoned waistcoat. The coloring sheet includes leafy garlands, draped fabric, and the crooked house in the background.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Pulling a Stack of Books From Her Enchanted Beaded Bag Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Hermione Granger pulling a stack of books from her enchanted beaded bag, holding three large volumes above the open drawstring pouch. The bag sits on a table inside a tent, with a lantern and trunk nearby. Its rows of round beads provide small repeated sections beside broad book covers and tent panels.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Casting Protective Enchantments Around a Forest Campsite Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermione Granger casts protective enchantments around a forest campsite in this printable coloring page, sweeping her raised wand through long spiraling lines and scattered stars. A small pitched tent stands behind her between the trees. The coloring sheet mixes wide robe sections and open sky with narrower magical ribbons, grass tufts, and textured tree trunks.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Dancing with Harry Potter Inside Their Tent During the Horcrux Hunt Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hermione Granger dancing with Harry Potter inside their tent during the Horcrux hunt, holding his hand beside a small radio. Hermione wears a fringed scarf, while Harry has round glasses and an open jacket. Beds, a storage trunk, and hanging tent fabric surround the figures, adding varied sections to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Planning the Gringotts Break-in with Griphook at Shell Cottage Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermione Granger plans the Gringotts break-in with Griphook at Shell Cottage in this printable coloring page, studying a floor plan spread across a table. She points to the map as Griphook indicates another area with a slender pointer. A lantern, hanging shells, and a window overlooking the coast add background details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Destroying Hufflepuff's Cup with a Basilisk Fang in the Chamber of Secrets Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hermione Granger destroying Hufflepuff's cup with a basilisk fang in the Chamber of Secrets, kneeling beside a stone ledge. The cup cracks beneath the pointed fang, with jagged bursts around the impact. Serpent carvings, flowing water, and arched stonework provide a detailed background to this coloring sheet's central action.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Kissing Ron Weasley in the Chamber of Secrets Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermione Granger kisses Ron Weasley in the Chamber of Secrets in this printable coloring page, with one hand on his arm as he holds her waist. Both wear long school robes beneath a broad stone arch. A coiled serpent carved around a nearby column adds patterned scales beside the larger clothing sections on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Dueling Bellatrix Lestrange Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Hermione Granger dueling Bellatrix Lestrange beside Ginny Weasley and Luna Lovegood during the Battle of Hogwarts, with all four wands raised. Hermione stands at the front as sparks gather between the opposing spells. Cracked courtyard paving, scattered stones, and tall castle windows create detailed background areas around the figures on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hermione Granger Seeing Rose Off on the Hogwarts Express with Ron Weasley at Platform Nine and Three-quarters Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermione Granger sees Rose off on the Hogwarts Express with Ron Weasley in this printable coloring page, standing beside the train at Platform Nine and Three-quarters. Rose holds an owl cage while Ron grips a wheeled trunk, and Hermione rests a hand on her daughter's shoulder. Scarf stripes, cage bars, and luggage fittings add small sections to the coloring sheet.
